subject: Positron AI raised $875M Series C for inference hardware

metrics.headline: Positron AI raised $875M Series C for inference hardware
metrics.body_excerpt: Positron AI raised $875 million Series C for inference hardware. One of the bigger non-GPU chip checks this month and points to inference, not training, as the next capacity bottleneck.
